mapper.select: SELECT * FROM archive_log WHERE item_id=#{itemId} ORDER BY log_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT i.id, i.title FROM `${itemTable}` i WHERE 1=1 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM archive_log l WHERE l.item_id=i.id AND l.log_date=#{day} AND l.log_type=#{logType} ) ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 200
